title: Canonical
problem: Truth surfaces contradict each other: package.json vs RELEASE.md versions, blockers vs current-state, Relay claimed unimplemented while code/UI exist, operator vs console docs, LOCAL_AI_BIND vs LOCAL_AI_HOST, generated dashboard vs open issues.

included: Single authoritative release version across package.json, RELEASE.md, README, and generated status
Reconcile README, RELEASE, current-state, roadmap, blockers, tester-feedback, and ux-principles
Generate status sections from canonical development JSON where practical
CI or offline checks for stale milestone references and contradictory feature-state claims
Fix LOCAL_AI_BIND vs LOCAL_AI_HOST documentation and examples
Verify console logo asset path and repair if broken
Remove obsolete claims that Relay Nodes are unimplemented
Decision record for whether /console and /operator stay separate routes or become one shell (implement decision only if trivial; otherwise document deferred to px4)
excluded: New product features or Golden Path Run Inspector UI
Rewriting Benchmark Lab or Relay protocol

acceptanceCriteria.description: One release version is authoritative and consistent across package.json, RELEASE.md, and README
No active doc claims Relay Nodes are unimplemented when protocol/UI/tests exist
Operator guide and related docs correctly distinguish /console vs /operator routes and launchers
All docs and examples use LOCAL_AI_HOST (not LOCAL_AI_BIND) matching companion/server.js
An automated check fails when known contradictory feature-state claims or missing milestone records are detected
Decision recorded in docs/06-decisions for console/operator shell strategy
node scripts/test-development-schemas.js and npm run dev:status pass without ERROR-level product-status contradictions introduced by this work
